subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant's Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the Software Engineer position at our company. We have carefully reviewed your qualifications and experience, and we are impressed with your skills. We would like to invite you for an interview to discuss further details. Please let us know your availability for next week so we can schedule a convenient time. We look forward to meeting you in person. Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
